% Beamer source: both nested-brace frame-title forms. convert_deck.py matches
% titles with [^{}]*, which cannot see the inner braces, so it silently leaves
% BOTH of these unconverted -- no error, no warning, and the frame ends up with
% no title at all (C-FRAMETITLE-NESTED). Ten frames shipped this way across
% three decks already signed off as clean.
\documentclass{beamer}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}[c]{\only<1>{Example}\only<2>{Find a plan for}}
Single braced title, nested.
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}[c]{Arc consistency}{{\sc Inference}}
Double braced title, nested.
\end{frame}
\end{document}
